day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaSaint Leo Omkhulu, uPapa noGqirha weCawa
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubukele umntwana wakho ebhala ikhowudi kwikhompyutha yakhe. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayehlala ejonge kwisikrini, kodwa wayengajongi nje imigca yamanani okanye i-AWS cloud infrastructure. Wayejonge ikamva, eyila imidlalo kunye nezo ndiza zakhe azibiza ngokuba yi-'con chim airlines'. Wayehleka, egigitheka, kwaye ebalisa nguyise ngendlela le nkampani yakhe encinci eya kubhabha ngayo. Kwakukho ukukhanya emehlweni akhe, ukukhanya okwakungaveli nje kubukrelekrele, kodwa entliziyweni eyayazi ukuba ubomi buphila xa usabelana ngobuchule bakho nabanye. Masiyimele kancinci le ndlela uBen awayeyila ngayo… Akazange ayenze le nto ngenxa yokuba efuna ukuduma, kodwa ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda indlela izinto ezisebenza ngayo, indlela iinkqubo ezidibana ngayo, nendlela uthando lwentsapho lwakha indawo ekhuselekileyo.

KwiNcwadi kaTitus namhlanje, uPawulos usinika umfanekiso onzulu: 'For the grace of God has appeared, saving all and training us to reject godless ways… and to live temperately, justly, and devoutly in this age.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UPawulos akathethi ngobomi obungenawo umdla okanye obungenawo umbala. Uthetha ngobomi obulungeleleneyo, obulungele ukwamkela ubabalo lukaThixo. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayeyiqonda ukuba ubomi buphila ngobubele. Khumbula lowo mzuzu apho uBen, eneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, waxelela abazali bakhe ukuba wayezimisele ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange yakhe encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayengafihli lutho xa kuthethwa ngokuthanda. Oku kukunika okungenamkhawulo, oku kuthando olungaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje ngaphambi kokuba siye phambili. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kukho amaxesha apho ukuziva usodwa kuhlasela ngaphandle kwesaziso, kwaye umthwalo wokulahlekelwa uba nzima kakhulu ukuba ungathwalwa. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha ngomsebenzi: 'So should it be with you. When you have done all you have been commanded, say, We are unprofitable servants; we have done what we were obliged to do.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYesu akathethi ngokungabikho kwexabiso lomntu. Uthetha ngokuthobeka. Uthetha ngokwazi ukuba konke esikwenzayo, konke esikwakhayo, konke esikunika abanye, kuvela kubabalo lukaThixo. UBen wayengumfana owayeyazi le nto. Wayeyazi ukuba ubukrelekrele bakhe, ukuhleka kwakhe, uthando lwakhe, zonke ezo zinto yayizizipho ezivela kuThixo. Wayengazicingeli njengomntu omkhulu; wayezicingela njengomntwana kaThixo owayesenza oko wayenokukwenza ngothando.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abaswelekileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abakhathazekileyo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abaphe ithemba eliqinileyo.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngokomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, ndize ndimanyane nawe ngokupheleleyo. Musa ukuvumela ukuba ndahlulwe kuwe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angasigcina emthunzini wothando lwakhe, ngoku nangonaphakade. Amen.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Sithandwa: Wena ke thetha izinto ezifanele imfundiso ephilileyo, ukuba amadoda amadala abe nengqondo, abe nesidima, azithibe, abe nempilo ekukholweni, ekuthandeni, nako kunyamezeleni. Kananjalo abafazi abadala mababe nesimilo esifanele abangcwele, bangabi ngabanyelisi, bangabi ngamakhoboka ewayini, bafundise okuhle, ukuze baqeqeshe abafazi abancinci ukuba babathande abayeni babo nabantwana babo, bazithibe, babe nococeko, babe ngabalondolozi bemizi emihle, bazithobe kwabayeni babo, ukuze ilizwi likaThixo linganyeliswa. Ube njalo ukubavuselela abafazi abancinci ukuba bazithibe. Zibonakalise wena umzekelo wemisebenzi emihle ezintweni zonke, ube nenyani ekufundiseni kwakho, ube nesidima, ube nentetho ephilileyo engenakugxekwa, ukuze ophikisayo adane, engenanto imbi angatsho ngayo ngathi. Kuba ubabalo lukaThixo olusindisa abantu bonke lubonakele, lusifundisa ukuba, siyikhanyele ukungahloneli Thixo, neenkanuko zehlabathi, siphile ngokuzithiba, nangobulungisa, nangokuhlonela Thixo kweli phakade, silindele ithemba elinoyolo, nokubonakala kobuqaqawuli boThixo omkhulu noMsindisi wethu uYesu Kristu, owazinikelayo ngenxa yethu, ukuze asikhulule kuko konke ukuchaswa komthetho, azicwengele abantu abangabakhe, abanenzondelelo yemisebenzi emihle.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Usindiso lwabalungileyo luvela eNkosini. Themba eNkosini, wenze okuhle; hlalani ezweni, uze wena utyiswe ngokunyaniseka. Uthabe kakhulu eNkosini; uya kukunika izicelo zentliziyo yakho. R. Usindiso lwabalungileyo luvela eNkosini. INkosi iyazazi imihla yabasulungekileyo; ilifa labo liya kuba ngunaphakade. Amanyathelo omntu amiselwa yiNkosi, iyakukholiswa yindlela yakhe. R. Usindiso lwabalungileyo luvela eNkosini. Phambuka kokubi, wenze okuhle; uya kuhlala ngonaphakade. Ababalungileyo baya kulidla ilifa ilizwe, bahlale kulo ngonaphakade. R. Usindiso lwabalungileyo luvela eNkosini.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubapostile: 'Ngubani na kuni onomkhonzi olima okanye aluse, othi kuye, akubuya ngasentsimini, athi, Khawuze kwangoko, uhlale phantsi utye? Akathi na kuye, Lungisa nditya, ubhinqe, undilungisele, ndide nditye ndisele, emveni koko uya kutya nawe, usele? Unombulelo na kuloo mkhonzi, ngokuba enze izinto awaziyalelwayo? Nani, xa nenze konke enikuyalelweyo, yithini, Singabakhonzi abangenancedo; senze oko besimelwe kukukwenza.'

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
